comment: Initial writer-to-file map for the parallel-writing flow. Seed entries only state what the writer briefs name explicitly; writers with empty paths/globs are unmapped and their intake is flagged until the chief architect assigns files here. Paths are engine-root-relative after root_prefix is stripped. Shared paths are merged by the chief architect by hand; the common rule is one-line call-site patches only.
